mapper.sql: r.region_id, r.sido_name, r.gugun_name, ht.tag_id, ht.tag_name, ht.tag_type, rht.weight, rht.confidence, rht.quiz_count, rht.evidence_source, rht.evidence_summary, rht.evidence_places, rht.source_url, rht.needs_review, rht.created_at, rht.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM region_history_tags rht JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = rht.region_id JOIN history_tags ht ON ht.tag_id = rht.tag_id WHERE rht.region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY rht.weight DESC, ht.tag_type, ht.tag_name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
